seed: none (the bodies are drawn without random draws; ages and wounds at the area defaults)

catalogue.source: packages/game-characters-undead/src/data (UNDEAD_TYPES) and packages/game-characters-people/src/data (PROFESSIONS), the items of the area

gaps: undead and professions are walked in place by the module: no ground speed, so no stance slide can be measured for them (only the player body moves)
no crouch or aim-walk clip is exposed for the undead types

the lowest point of one undead type is not the same on every sheet or run (zombie_walker read -0.043 to -0.051 m, and the colour of the part that holds it changes between sheets): each spawn looks to draw its own variant, but the source of the variation was not found, so the sink limit is judged on the lowest point rounded to the centimetre (tools/check-area/contact-sheet.mjs) and a body that reads between -0.045 and -0.055 m is not told apart from the limit

camera.framing: looks at the middle of the row from the distance that fits it
